app.name: Calmline Boundary Shield
app.short_description: Warns an agent when simulated call language becomes abusive.
app.long_description: A Support ticket sidebar for Boundary Shield. It plays synthetic call transcripts and shows the warning ladder. It does not access Zendesk Talk audio or live Voice transcripts.
app.installation_instructions: Upload this private app, then open a ticket. The sidebar stays on Monitoring until a qualifying abusive customer transcript event arrives. It does not read the ticket body or live call audio. The simulated call is only in the local demo.
